overview: 125 official Group 1 Prelims questions (2008–2024): international events 77, national 44, Andhra Pradesh 4. Up to 2019 almost all were one-liners from the previous 12 months (who won, who heads, where held, which date); 2023–24 shift to 2–5-statement, matching and multiple-correct items on groupings, awards editions, missions and defence news, where one member, edition, agency or venue is swapped.

possibility.angle: Andhra Pradesh current events (GI tags, AP personalities, state laws, tourism)
possibility.what_they_ask: newest GI item from AP, AP sportsperson, a recent AP Act's dates and content, a facility on an AP route (Vistadome coach, Vizag–Araku)

possibility.angle: National awards and honours (Padma, Jnanpith, Arjuna, SNA, film)
possibility.what_they_ask: recipient of a given edition, awardee's field, count of awardees in a category, who is NOT a recipient

possibility.angle: National polity, defence and governance news
possibility.evidence: G/2 (44 Qs across all seven years) incl. 2008 Rajya Sabha, 2012 Air Chief, 2019 CBI, 2023 War Memorial, 2024 navy ships, state schemes
possibility.what_they_ask: who holds an office, date/venue of inauguration or commissioning, which state launched a scheme, numbers from an election

possibility.evidence: part of G/2: 2017 (Jitu Rai, SAI board), 2019 (Divyansh Panwar, Aparna Kumar), 2024 (Khelo India Para Games)
possibility.what_they_ask: sport of an athlete, which state topped a medal table, first Indian woman/officer to achieve a feat

possibility.evidence: part of G/3 (77 Qs, all seven years): 2008 Cuba/Turkey, 2010 UK election, 2012 China PM, 2023 I2U2, 2024 PNG PM
possibility.what_they_ask: head of state/government, party, election date, members of a minilateral grouping, summit number and venue (SAARC, ASEAN)

possibility.evidence: part of G/3: 2010 Nobels, 2012 Right Livelihood, 2017 Pulitzer/Happiness, 2019 UNESCO press prize, Global Teacher, UNCTAD, 2023 Magsaysay, IMD index
possibility.what_they_ask: winner and country, publisher of an index, India's rank, statement from a report
winner and margin, venue of a World Cup, opening match, terms linked to a game (mashie – golf, raider – kabaddi)

possibility.angle: International science, space and environment news
possibility.evidence: part of G/3: 2010 (Atlantis), 2017 (Peggy Whitson), 2023 (Chang'e-5), 2024 (H3, OSIRIS-APEX, PACE, malaria vaccine)
possibility.what_they_ask: which agency launched a rocket/spacecraft, mission target, first country to roll out a vaccine

possibility.evidence: part of G/3: 2023 (SWIFT), 2024 (Operation Aspides, Trinidad oil spill)
possibility.what_they_ask: headquarters, founding year, nature and powers of an institution; who runs a military operation

traps.trap: [G/3] Look-alike country in an acronym grouping
traps.spot: options differ only by Indonesia/Israel or UK/UAE
traps.fix: Decode the acronym by members: I2U2 = India, Israel + USA, UAE
traps.pyq: 'I2U2 is a new partnership between' → Israel, India, UAE, USA [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#111]

traps.spot: edition number (57th/58th) with a list of genuine laureates
traps.fix: Pair each edition with its winners: 57th Jnanpith Damodar Mauzo; 58th Gulzar + Rambhadracharya

traps.trap: Agency/country swapped in a 'first since' claim
traps.spot: historic mission attributed to the better-known agency (NASA)
traps.fix: Luna = Soviet; Apollo = NASA; Chang'e = China

traps.trap: Every attribute of an institution altered
traps.spot: four statements on HQ, year, nature, powers of one body
traps.fix: SWIFT: Belgium (La Hulpe), 1973, messaging not payment, no sanction power – all four can be false
traps.pyq: SWIFT I–IV all false → None of the above [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#114]

traps.trap: Inauguration year shifted to a later related event
traps.spot: a memorial's year close to a later linked event
traps.fix: National War Memorial inaugurated 25 Feb 2019; Amar Jawan Jyoti merged 2022

traps.trap: Operation credited to an international police/shipping body
traps.fix: Naval operations are run by states/blocs: Aspides = EU; Prosperity Guardian = US-led

traps.trap: Venue and ship list swapped in defence news
traps.spot: ship names plus a location for a ceremony
traps.fix: Cheetah, Guldar, Kumbhir decommissioned at Port Blair (12 Jan 2024)
traps.pyq: '… Magar … at Lakshadweep' → Kumbhir, Port Blair [group1-prelims-2024-paper2#115]

traps.trap: Para and deaf categories swapped in award matching
traps.spot: a matching list with both para badminton and deaf badminton
traps.fix: Arjuna 2022: Tarun Dhillon – para badminton; Jerlin Anika – deaf badminton
traps.pyq: Arjuna 2022 match → a–v, b–i, c–ii, d–iii, e–iv [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#101]

traps.trap: Report's view reversed in a mirror option
traps.spot: two options say opposite things about the same claim
traps.fix: One of the mirror pair is the source's view; recall its tone (TDR 2017 cautious: India/China not yet growth poles)
traps.pyq: UNCTAD TDR 2017 'will become growth poles' → not correct [group1-prelims-2019-paper2#114]

techniques.name: [G/3] Acronym decoding
techniques.how: Expand each letter of a grouping's name; keep only options where every member fits a letter.
techniques.example: I2U2 = two I's + two U's → Indonesia/UK options fail the pairing with known members → Israel, India, UAE, USA [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#111]

techniques.name: Edition ladder
techniques.how: For numbered awards/summits, recall the last two editions with winners/venues; an item from the neighbouring edition is the usual distractor.
techniques.example: 56th Phookan, 57th Mauzo, 58th Gulzar + Rambhadracharya → III falls → I and II only [group1-prelims-2024-paper2#106]

techniques.name: Mirror-pair elimination
techniques.how: When two options contradict each other, the answer to 'not correct' is one of them; drop the other options first.
techniques.example: Options 3 and 4 are opposites; 2.6% and 'picking up but not lifting off' match the report → option 4 is the incorrect one [group1-prelims-2019-paper2#114]

techniques.name: Nature-of-institution test
techniques.how: Ask what the body actually does (messages, pays, regulates, sanctions); statements giving it powers outside its nature are false.
techniques.example: SWIFT only carries messages → 'payment network' and 'can impose sanctions' false; Belgium, 1973 → None of the above [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#114]

techniques.name: Anchor one sure statement, then codes
techniques.how: Use the statement you know best to strike codes; check remaining differences only.
techniques.example: NWM inaugurated 2019 → I false → only 'II, III and IV only' survives [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#109]

techniques.name: Term-to-game association
techniques.how: Match jargon to its sport by how it is used in play.
techniques.example: 'Mashie' is an old golf iron → Golf [group1-prelims-2010#49]; 'Raider' → Kabaddi [group1-prelims-2010-reexam#78]

confusions.remember: I2U2 = West Asian Quad; Quad = Indo-Pacific
Luna 24 (1976) was the last lunar sample return before Chang'e-5 (2020)
Swiss HQ belongs to BIS; SWIFT is in La Hulpe, Belgium
All Red Sea/Gulf shipping security; Aspides = EU, defensive
NWM honours post-1947 soldiers; Amar Jawan Jyoti merged into it in 2022
IMD Lausanne publishes the World Competitiveness ranking
Ostrom and Williamson = Economics 2009; Steitz = Chemistry 2009
Tarzan = Edgar Rice Burroughs; Voldemort = J.K. Rowling
Amartya Sen won the Nobel/Bharat Ratna, never the Jnanpith

anchors: I2U2 – India, Israel, UAE, USA (first leaders' summit July 2022)
National War Memorial – 25 Feb 2019; four concentric chakras
58th Jnanpith – Gulzar and Jagadguru Rambhadracharya; 57th – Damodar Mauzo
Chang'e-5 (2020) – China's first lunar sample return; first since Soviet Luna 24 (1976)
INS Imphal – Project 15B destroyer, commissioned 26 Dec 2023, Mumbai
Cameroon – first routine childhood malaria vaccination (2024)
OSIRIS-APEX – NASA probe to Apophis ('God of Chaos'), 2029 flyby
Bhanu Athaiya – first Indian Oscar (costume design, Gandhi)
Bihar – Mission Investigation@75 days; Rajasthan – Mukhyamantri Vishwakarma Pension Yojana
Banganapalle mango – GI from AP (keyed as recent in 2017)
checklist: Which edition/year is asked? Rule out the neighbouring edition's item.
Groupings: decode the acronym and check every member.
Missions and operations: confirm the agency or bloc, not the famous name.
Institutions: test HQ, founding year, function and powers one by one.
Dates of inauguration/commissioning: separate the event from later linked events.
Mirror options: one of the pair is usually the key.
